merged_issues.title: Missing or empty document title
merged_issues.description: The page does not have a non-empty <title> element. A descriptive title helps screen reader users understand the page context and improves navigation and discoverability.
merged_issues.recommended_fix: Add a meaningful, non-empty <title> inside the document <head>, e.g. <head><title>Descriptive page name</title>...</head>. Ensure it reflects the page purpose and is unique where appropriate.

merged_issues.title: Missing main landmark
merged_issues.description: The document does not include a main landmark, which helps assistive technology users quickly jump to the primary content area.
merged_issues.recommended_fix: Wrap the primary page content in a single <main> element (or add role="main" to the main content container). Ensure there is only one main landmark per page and it does not appear inside repeated content like headers/sidebars.
